errors.media_video_format: Only {{postVideoFormats}} videos are accepted, so that they play on every phone: this one is not sent. Record or export it in one of these formats, then choose it again.
errors.media_video_too_long: This video is too long: it must last {{postVideoMaxMinutes}} min at most. Shorten it, then choose it again.
errors.media_video_too_long_to_convert: This video must be converted to play on every phone, and the conversion happens here, in real time: beyond {{postVideoConvertMaxMinutes}} min, it would take too long. This one is not sent. Record or export it in one of these formats: {{postVideoFormats}}, then choose it again.
errors.media_video_conversion_failed: Converting this video failed: it is not sent. Record or export it in one of these formats: {{postVideoFormats}}, then choose it again.
errors.media_video_converted_too_large: Even once converted, this video exceeds {{postVideoMaxMegabytes}} MB: it is not sent. Shorten it, then choose it again.
errors.media_cancelled: Cancelled: this file is not attached to the post.

composer.videoKeepVisible: The video is converted here, in real time, so that it plays on every phone: keep this tab visible until it finishes.
composer.videoPreparing: Preparing the video: publishing will wait.
composer.videoCancelled: Conversion cancelled: the video was not added.
